metric: Equal weight per inventoried gateway source component with native implementation and reviewed focused contracts; not an estimate of effort or cutover readiness.

State path and explicit DB path precedence, test-mode refusal and ECMAScript whitespace. Platform-specific path rules still need supported-platform validation.
Exact UUID bytes under deterministic timestamp/entropy and UUIDv7 random uniqueness/layout.
WAL, foreign keys and sync settings, migration error tracking, repair idempotence, rollback, backup and TypeScript reopen.

All account route families over real HTTP: login/register/refresh/logout cookies, owner-only invitations, expiry and one-time use, settings filtering/nulls/model limits, tool locks, environment status, archived cleanup, session binding, deleted users and origin denials. Real SQLite reads/upserts/deletes, per-session and optional-key isolation, cross-session key lookup, primitive/nested JSON, empty/invalid/nullable stored JSON and proto-key JSON behavior. Repository boundary has no route authority; HTTP adapters must authorize access.

Real SQLite project state, filtered reads and writes, fragmented UI-state migration including exact trigger and durable side effects, legacy response retention, empty-filter behavior, nullish layout precedence and truthy existing UI values.

Default/cap environment parsing, invalid/zero/negative/nonfinite inputs, JavaScript coercion of strings/booleans/null/arrays/objects, base-prefixed numbers, fractional rounding and reference clamp warnings. Session CRUD, nullable updates, optional owner filters, project and personal scopes, list limits, monotonic activity, observed viewed acknowledgements, metadata/error UTF-16 handling, immutable history forks and transactional rollback compared against disposable production SQLite. Ordered handler identities, deduplication, wildcard matching, unsubscribe, mutation during emission, nested events and handler failure propagation compared with production HookBus. Built-in bootstrap file order, project/default roots, invalid UTF-8 decoding, missing files and read errors compared on disposable project-local files. Disposable SQLite comparison of create/read/update, null patches, root-derived kind, colors, optional ownership, limits, ancestor-preserving pagination with owned sessions, search and counts, directory adoption, move cycle/depth rejection, instruction inheritance and exact UTF-16 truncation, repository metadata, subtree archive/restore/delete and SQLite trigger partial failures. Production settings and session-state comparisons for trimmed identifiers, optional services, omitted fields, inherited provider/model/effort/runtime, invalid value shapes, 64-character reasoning-effort limits and storage error propagation. Thread replay builder compared against the production TypeScript function over an explicit activity source: stable timestamp ordering and tie reversal, role/payload filtering, full-content precedence, 24-message and 12000 UTF-16-unit budgets, original-task preservation, task/location/execution checkpoints, six outcomes, latest todo, lone-surrogate truncation and source error propagation. Actual Fastify/native HTTP comparisons for immutable asset names/types, querystrings, empty/binary bodies, conditional/range/non-GET fallthrough, immutable hits, missing files/directories/symlinks, 100KiB inclusive file ceiling, cached oversized misses, 256-entry LRU and 16MiB budget. Cache mounting is opt-in; full frontend fallback, auth integration and supported-platform recovery remain replacement gates.

Production SQLite comparison of memory save/update/list/forget/expiry, scope filtering, provenance, createdAt preservation, omitted nullable expiry, inclusive UTC expiry boundaries, no-delete listing, duplicate IDs, trigger rollback and missing tables. Production BM25 comparisons for ASCII token boundaries, Unicode lowercasing cases, stop words, plural folding, query-term deduplication, document frequencies, length saturation, zero matches, document-order retention and a varied corpus. Floating scores use an explicit 1e-12 relative/absolute tolerance; items/tokens are exact. Callers scope the corpus before ranking; the memory retrieval engine is not credited.

Caller-scoped engine over real SQLite: source/content replacement precedence and lexical threshold, stable creation time/provenance, inclusive expiry, relative BM25 cutoff and stable freshness ties, JS numeric slice limits, durable pre-compaction filtering/deduplication/20-fact ceiling, exact daily/curated log contents, failed storage and log writes with durable partial effects. Provider injection and HTTP/tool access remain unported.

Shared session/thread/surface/consent ownership checks: 108 user/resource combinations, owner overrides and fallback, pending-only consent, missing stores, two distinct owned default execution sessions, SQL failures. Real session storage; typed surface/consent/thread boundaries use fixture adapters. Relaxing an explicit surface owner fails the differential contract; restoration passes.

Real filesystem comparisons for registered read-only common Git metadata mounts, spaces/relative pointers/CRLF/multiline markers, forged backlink/admin/common paths, colon rejection, symlink/dangling markers, ordinary checkouts and absent roots. Register/reregister metadata, exact capability deduplication/order, preserved connection time, heartbeat existence/last-seen updates, stable ordering for equal canonical timestamps, count, empty IDs and Unicode. Hash lookup preserves constant-time updates.

Retained-buffer offsets, partial-line prefix recovery, bounded command output bypassing live tail limits, end-marker trimming, empty buffers, fractional/nonfinite offsets and line limits across 218 cases. 168 shell/line pairs: PowerShell executable/path casing, host/user/path prompts, false positives and ECMAScript whitespace/line terminators. Detection only; process execution remains unported.

100 routing cases: explicit gateway/remote/offline IDs, local-path precedence, Windows drive detection and platform selection, gateway filtering, empty nodes and ECMAScript trimming. Node transport execution remains unported.

Exact base headers and Go URL/backend detection, explicit/configured/generated session precedence, repeated-config identity versus distinct configurations, empty IDs, host/path false positives. Exact raw JSON retention, malformed/nonarray rejection, field type/default/optional metadata rules, three compaction passes, byte limits and floored minimum budgets, Unicode byte boundaries, metadata-only fallback and prefix truncation. Focused contracts use finite-number, well-formed Unicode JSON; JS-specific nonfinite overflow and unpaired surrogate parsing remain compatibility limits.
